notes: This contract pins the existing official C++ Create Federation Execution single-FOM surface to the bounded source-readability boundary. Public cases distinguish a missing designator (CouldNotOpenFOM) from an existing non-file source (ErrorReadingFOM), and prove that a later valid create can use the same federation name after either failure. It does not claim every declared Create exception, complete FOM composition, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, or conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void createFederationExecution( std::wstring const & federationName, std::wstring const & fomModule, std::wstring const & logicalTimeImplementationName = L"") = 0
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_fom_source_diagnostics_catch2.cpp::Embedded Create Federation Execution maps an existing non-file FOM source to ErrorReadingFOM
cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_fom_source_diagnostics_catch2.cpp::Embedded Create Federation Execution maps a missing FOM source to CouldNotOpenFOM
